exposure: timing of antenatal betamethasone administration (up to 10 days prior to birth vs. earlier in pregnancy)
cohort: The study observed 97 late preterm infants (34/0-36/0 weeks of gestation) who were exposed to antenatal betamethasone, derived from a real-world population and a simulated high-risk population from the University Hospital Magdeburg.
finding: In a simulated high-risk population, recent antenatal corticosteroid administration significantly reduced the incidence of relevant cardiorespiratory morbidities, with its superiority over earlier exposure being dependent on the prevalence of respiratory disease.
